topic: Stiff lower back after a long flight

slides.headline: Long flight, stiff lower back?
slides.sub: What to do in the air and in the first day after landing.

slides.title: Why flights stiffen you up
slides.body: Hours sitting in a cramped seat with little room to shift can leave your lower back stiff and achy. It's usually about stillness, not damage, and it often eases within a day or two.

slides.title: In the air: move every hour
slides.body: Get up for a short aisle walk when it's safe. In your seat, try pelvic tilts, gentle knee lifts and ankle circles. A rolled jumper behind your lower back can help too.

slides.title: Handle cabin bags in two steps
slides.body: Wheel bags where you can, and lift cabin luggage close to your body in two steps: onto the seat, then into the locker. Heavy overhead lifts at an awkward angle tend to provoke sore backs.

slides.title: After landing: walk it out
slides.body: Resist collapsing onto the hotel bed. A 10 to 20 minute walk, a warm shower and a few gentle back stretches usually help things loosen up more than resting all day.

slides.title: When to get it checked
slides.body: Get checked promptly if back pain comes with leg weakness, numbness around the groin, or bladder or bowel changes. Calf pain with swelling or sudden breathlessness after a flight needs urgent care.

slides.headline: Still stiff days after landing?
slides.body: Book with our chiropractors at Hybrid Physiotherapy. We'll assess your lower back, use hands-on care where it helps and give you exercises to keep moving.

caption:
Landed with a lower back that feels welded in place? Very common after a long flight.

Hours in a cramped seat with little chance to shift usually means stiffness, not damage. In the air, take a short aisle walk when it's safe, and try pelvic tilts, knee lifts and ankle circles in your seat. Lift cabin bags in two steps, close to your body.

After landing, go for a 10 to 20 minute walk and a warm shower before you rest. It usually helps more than lying down all day.

Get checked promptly for leg weakness, numbness around the groin or bladder changes. Calf pain with swelling or sudden breathlessness after flying needs urgent medical care.

Still stiff days later? Our chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio.

story.headline: Stiff back after flying?
story.body: Move every hour on board, lift bags in two steps and walk for 10 to 20 minutes after landing.
